# MedleyHR

> MedleyHR is a self-serve HR and payroll management platform built specifically for Indian businesses. It lets any company run payroll, manage leaves, track attendance, and stay compliant with Indian labour law — without an implementation consultant or a months-long setup.

## What is MedleyHR?

MedleyHR is an HRMS (Human Resource Management System) operated by Codonsoft Technologies, Bengaluru, India. It is designed for Indian companies of all sizes — from 5-person startups to multi-branch enterprises — who want to own their HR operations without depending on consultants or spreadsheets.

The platform is fully self-serve: sign up, configure, and run your first payroll on the same day. Most teams complete setup in under a few hours.

## Key Capabilities

- **Payroll automation**: Calculate salaries, deductions, and net pay automatically. Supports custom salary components, arrears, and bonus processing.
- **India statutory compliance**: PF (Provident Fund), ESI, TDS, Professional Tax, and Form 16 — handled out of the box, updated automatically with regulatory changes.
- **Leave management**: Configure leave policies, track balances, and manage approval workflows.
- **Attendance and working hours**: Track working hours, shifts, and attendance records.
- **Employee self-service**: Employees can view payslips, apply for leave, submit reimbursements, and update personal details without HR intervention.
- **Loans and reimbursements**: Manage salary advances and expense reimbursements within the payroll cycle.
- **Salary revision approvals**: Structured workflow for salary changes with approval chains.
- **Multi-branch reporting**: Manage multiple office locations, departments, and pay schedules under one organisation.
- **Team status module**: Real-time visibility into team availability and escalation management (Scale plan).
- **Direct bank integration**: Disburse salaries directly to employee bank accounts (Scale plan).

## Pricing

MedleyHR offers three plans, billed per employee per month:

- **Starter** — Free, for up to 10 employees. Includes core HR, payslip generation, leave management, employee self-service, and basic reports. No credit card required.
- **Growth** — ₹35/employee/month (₹29 billed annually). Full payroll suite with approval workflows, attendance, loans and reimbursements, Form 16 and TDS, salary revision approvals, and multi-branch reporting. 2 months free on annual billing.
- **Scale** — ₹55/employee/month (₹46 billed annually). Everything in Growth plus team status module, escalation management, direct bank integration, custom salary components, priority support, and a dedicated account manager. 2 months free on annual billing.

All prices are in Indian Rupees (INR), exclusive of GST. No setup fee. No implementation cost. No contracts.

## Who Uses MedleyHR?

MedleyHR is built for:
- Indian SMEs and startups that have outgrown spreadsheet-based payroll
- HR managers who want to run payroll without depending on an external consultant
- Finance teams that need India-compliant statutory filings automated
- Multi-location businesses that need centralised HR across branches

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Can MedleyHR migrate data from another HRMS?**
Yes. Connect last month's payroll data during setup and run the next payroll without a gap. Most teams complete migration within a day.

**Is MedleyHR compliant with Indian tax laws?**
Yes. PF, ESI, TDS, PT, and Form 16 are handled out of the box and updated automatically when regulations change.

**Do I need a consultant to set up MedleyHR?**
No. MedleyHR is fully self-serve. Sign up, configure your organisation, and you are ready to run payroll. Most teams are set up within a day.

**Is payroll data secure on MedleyHR?**
Yes. 256-bit SSL encryption, role-based access controls, and regular security audits. Your data belongs to you and is never sold.

**Can MedleyHR handle multiple offices?**
Yes. Multi-branch support is available on the Growth and Scale plans, with separate departments, locations, and pay schedules under one organisation.
